## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem it Solves
What problem does this feature address? What's the current limitation?

## Proposed Solution
How would you like this to work? Describe the behavior you'd expect.

## Alternatives Considered
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've thought of.

## Use Case
Who would benefit from this feature? (e.g., forensic investigators, security researchers)

## Additional Context
Any other context, mockups, or references that would help.
